sections.A: Kandha jism ka sab se zyada hilne wala jor hai; chhoti socket mein bara gola, is liye stability muscles aur ligaments par hai. Instability mein jor khisakta ya utar jata hai.
sections.B: Kandha phisalne, utarne ya clunk ka ehsaas, khaas kar baazu side mein aur bahar ki taraf ghuma kar (phenkna, overhead).
sections.C: Kya kandha kabhi utra, kitni dafa, kisne chadhaya, aur kaun si position mein dar lagta hai.
sections.D: Muscles ka sukhna, scapula, gardan screen aur axillary nerve (baazu ke bahar sensation) zaroor check karein.
sections.E: Instability tests mein patient ka dar (apprehension) ahem hai, sirf dard nahi. Relocation se dar kam ho to instability ka ishara.
sections.F: Rotator cuff ka dard, labral tear aur doosri wajahein table mein hain.
sections.G: Chot ke baad nazar aane wali kharabi aur baazu na hilna, ya thanda, peela, nabz ke baghair haath: emergency.
sections.H: Kharabi ya nerve-khoon ke signs: emergency. Utarne ki history aur apprehension-relocation positive: working diagnosis instability.
sections.I: Muscle guarding ke liye soft tissue aur thoracic mobilisation. Capsule ko stretch karna aksar nahi.
sections.J: Cuff aur scapula ki dynamic stability un positions mein banayein jo patient control kar sake, phir dheere dheere mushkil aur khel wali positions.
sections.K: Barf, garmi, TENS optional; taping ya brace kuch logon mein.
sections.L: Pehli dafa utre to reduction aur imaging ke liye refer karein. Phir dard-free range, taaqat aur aakhir mein khel par wapsi.
sections.M: Apprehension, relocation, taaqat, scapula control aur functional tests dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 20 saal ke rugby player ka kandha 3 hafte pehle utra tha. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: chot mein pehle sahi medical care, phir rehab.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
